system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: You can create `AGENTS.md` files to add custom instructions. You can also replace the entire system prompt.

env_context_strategy.note: Project scan injected plus grep/read tools for navigation.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Compaction uses the built-in prompt at `prompts/compact.md` by default.
context_compaction.note: Auto-compaction; ADR 0004 requires bounded tool output: "Keep tool output bounded and safe for LLM context".

observation_format.evidence_quote: Image attachments via `@` mentions — `.png`, `.jpg`, `.jpeg`, `.gif`, `.webp` files are sent to vision-capable models

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Manage a `todo` list to track the agent's work.
planning_granularity.note: Also a `plan` agent and plan review events.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Manage a `todo` list to track the agent's work.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: **`--continue`** or **`-c`**: Continue from the most recent saved session

self_verification.evidence_quote: Fires after every assistant turn that ends without pending tool calls.
self_verification.note: No harness-run tests/linters/judge by default; user-authored hooks could add checks.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: `decision: "deny"` + `reason` — `reason` is injected as a new user message asking for a retry. Capped at **3 retries per hook per user turn**
retry_policy.note: No default task-level retry; hook-driven retry is opt-in fixed_n.

rollback.evidence_quote: Automatic cleanup only applies to worktrees Vibe created this run

termination_condition.evidence_quote: **`--max-turns N`**: Limit the maximum number of assistant turns. The session will stop after N turns.
termination_condition.note: --max-price and --max-tokens too; interactive ends when the model stops.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: **`--max-tokens N`**: Set a maximum cumulative LLM token budget for the session

timeouts.evidence_quote: `tool_timeout_sec`: Timeout in seconds for tool execution (default 60s)

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Execute shell commands, with managed shell sessions, polling, and stdin helpers available during rollout.

network_policy.evidence_quote: Mistral Vibe supports proxy configuration for environments that require network traffic to go through a proxy server.

permission_model.evidence_quote: Shell permission analysis covers semantic execution rather than only top-level command text. It recursively inspects nested command constructs and normalizes shell-native paths before workspace-boundary checks
permission_model.note: Per-tool permission = ask/always plus allowlists/denylists and pre_tool hooks.

tracing.evidence_quote: Vibe can export traces for agent, model, and tool operations over OTLP/HTTP. Enable tracing in `config.toml`

replayability.evidence_quote: **`--resume SESSION_ID`**: Resume a specific session by ID (supports partial matching)
